# Mongolia development

Follow AGENTS.md and SPEC.md. v0.1 source is statically checked scalar/rank-2 tensor code with
immutable variables and functions. Future AD, GPU, packages and ownership syntax is not executable.
Keep bilingual aliases semantically identical. Use Result diagnostics, safe UTF-8 spans and checked
allocation arithmetic. Never claim tests passed without executing them. Update tests and docs with
semantic changes; do not create empty backend crates.
